opening.text: I've had blood in my urine, which I first noticed yesterday morning. I also have to go to the bathroom every 2 to 3 hours now, and I have to strain when I pass urine. My urine stream is weak. I take allopurinol and I smoke cigarettes. My father died at age 80 because of a kidney problem.
